SELECT a.id, a.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, a.lesson_date AS lessonDate, st.name AS studentName, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) AS courseName, t.name AS teacherName, a.status, a.lessons, a.checked_at AS checkedAt, a.remark FROM attendance a JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = a.campus_id JOIN student st ON st.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = a.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = cg.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = a.teacher_id
ORDER BY a.lesson_date DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = '出勤'), 0) AS present, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = '请假'), 0) AS leaveCount, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = '缺席'), 0) AS absent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '出勤' THEN a.lessons ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lessons FROM attendance a JOIN student st ON st.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = a.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = cg.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = a.teacher_id
SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM attendance a JOIN staff t ON t.id = a.teacher_id WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.name <> '' ORDER BY t.name
